rapport_notes: Patient with a rambling, detail-heavy customer; captured inventory accurately but the tone was more transactional than warm.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's concern was professional handling / no damage; rep reassured once ('our movers are... professionally trained') without asking a follow-up question or naming the specific $2,000 coverage.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: N/A -- call ended immediately after price was quoted (customer rejected the $545-$777 range as too high and asked to cancel) before Stage 3 differentiators were reached.

top_strength: Captured a detailed, accurate inventory from a rambling customer efficiently.
coaching_note: The pricing pitch skipped straight from the hourly rate to the estimate -- damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, and On-Time Guarantee were never mentioned, so no value was built before the price landed and the customer balked.
